name: Beijing Chindata Co., Ltd. (北京秦淮数据有限公司) and affiliated operating companies — Chindata China
employees: Not disclosed; 115 R&D staff at 28 Feb 2026 (HEC inquiry reply)

ownership.notes: Chindata China is not one company: HEC's filing defines 秦淮数据 as the operating companies controlled by 宜昌东数三号投资有限责任公司 — eight core companies (seven foreign-invested subsidiaries and a former VIE) plus new Yichang, Shaoguan, Ulanqab and Zhongwei subsidiaries; the IDC licence is held by 北京秦淮数据有限公司. Bain Capital's WinTriX DC Group (the renamed Chindata Group Holdings, taken private in 2023) sold 100% to a consortium led by HEC (东阳光) for RMB28.0B; signed 2025-09-10, closed 2026-01-16. The holding company 宜昌东数一号 'has no controlling shareholder and no actual controller'; the listed HEC Technology (SSE 600673) holds 30% and is issuing shares to buy the rest, pending SSE approval and CSRC registration. Bridge Data Centres, the former international arm, stayed with Bain and is a separate company; a five-year mutual non-compete from 2026-01-16 keeps Chindata China inside mainland China.

summary: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT: Chindata China runs what it calls the industry's first commercial SST-powered compute project — a Delta silicon-carbide solid-state transformer converting 10 kV AC to 800 V DC in one step, built for Meituan at the Sangyuan campus in Huailai and declared in formal operation on 2 Jul 2026 — and says it will scale SST use while working with domestic equipment makers on core components to localise them. The 'first' is Chindata's own claim and holds only as 'commercial': Eaton says an SST pilot at a VNET site in North China has run since end-2024. It is also the landlord behind most of ByteDance's rented North China capacity: its acquirer discloses that one unnamed customer took 90.12% of 2025 revenue on mostly 10-year contracts, and lists that customer's own campuses as Volcano Engine projects. It has 800 MW in service (end-Feb 2026), 886 MW signed but undelivered, and 824 MW of new orders in Jan–Aug 2026 including several hundred MW from a newly won internet company. BACKGROUND: Founded in August 2015 and later controlled by Wangsu; Bain Capital bought it in 2019 (Mingtiandi dates Bain's first investment to 2018), combined it with Bridge Data Centres, listed it on Nasdaq in 2020 and took it private in 2023 at US$8.60 per ADS (US$3.16B equity); the China business was sold to an HEC-led consortium for RMB28.0B (closed 16 Jan 2026), and HEC's listed company is buying out the other investors. 2025 revenue RMB6.37–6.38B; 2024 carve-out net profit RMB1.31B. PUE 1.21 in 2025 and 1.18 in Feb 2026. Its buying rule matters to any power vendor: for equipment it tenders among the vendors on the customer's qualified-vendor list, then buys that vendor's UPS. Named power suppliers: Delta (SST), Changshan Beiming (power modules and UPS), Eaton through its agent, Cummins (gensets), HOPPECKE and Shoto (batteries); Huawei and Schneider are named among core-equipment makers. Megmeet appears nowhere in either HEC filing.
ecosystemRole: We assess Chindata China as the corpus's first Chinese wholesale landlord and the clearest named site where a solid-state transformer carries a production AI load in China. Basis: Chindata's own release dates formal commercial operation of the Sangyuan SST project to 2 Jul 2026 and says it wrote the SST technical specification 'from 0 to 1' and led the full-chain design, after 34 performance and safety tests; Delta supplied the SST; HEC supplied custom stacked-foil capacitors; Meituan is the tenant. Chindata is third among third-party operators in China by in-service capacity (9.7%) and first around Beijing (22.7%), per Frost & Sullivan research commissioned for HEC's filing. For a power-electronics seller the landlord is a door with two locks: the landlord writes the architecture — 800 V HVDC plus SST plus storage at three levels is its stated direction — but for UPS it buys from the tenant's approved list. Chindata's stated intent to localise SST core components is the explicit opening for domestic SST and power-module makers; the Delta project is the incumbent reference.

productsAndServices.name: Wholesale hyperscale capacity — build-to-suit campuses
productsAndServices.description: Chindata leases whole data-centre modules or campuses: 'the data-centre module or campus is the smallest leasing unit, with customised technical solutions and equipment selection' — the tenant brings its servers, Chindata customises rack layout, power and cooling, and bills monthly by racks or billed capacity. Wholesale is 97.7% of revenue and retail 2.3% (Beijing and Shenzhen). Contracts are 'mostly 10 years'; the first wholesale contract expires in November 2027 and renewal talks had not started at the September 2026 filing. The sales team is 'organised by large internet customer'.
highlights: 800.15 MW in service and 733.39 MW billed at 28 Feb 2026 (91.66% utilisation); 799.34 MW in service at end-2025
886.17 MW signed but undelivered (547.84 MW binding, 338.33 MW reserved); 824.17 MW of new orders Jan–Aug 2026, including several hundred MW from a newly won top internet company
Two contract models: power-inclusive (包电) and power pass-through (非包电)

productsAndServices.name: Campus portfolio — capital ring, Yangtze Delta, Greater Bay Area and the northwest
productsAndServices.description: In service at end-Feb 2026: capital ring (Huailai in Zhangjiakou, Hebei, and Lingqiu in Datong, Shanxi) 780.30 MW; Yangtze Delta (Nantong) 15.09 MW; Greater Bay Area retail 4.76 MW. Huailai hosts the headquarters base, the Sangyuan base (site of the SST), the Cunrui base and the Guantinghu/Donghuayuan base; Lingqiu's Taihangshan base runs phases 1–9 with an own 220 kV substation. New campuses under HEC: Qingyang (Gansu), Zhongwei (Ningxia; RMB24B, 1.2 GW framework), Shaoguan (Guangdong; phase 1 150 MW), Ulanqab (Inner Mongolia; a GW-scale direct-green-power zone) and a 7.5 MW showcase at Yidu, Hubei.
highlights: Pipeline: 2,289.48 MW under construction or to start by 2028 plus 3,820.88 MW long-term — 6,110.36 MW in total (HEC reply)
Website, 'as of Q3 2026': 860 MW operating, 660 MW under construction, over 8 GW planned
Lingqiu's 220 kV substation (2023): 360 MW, stepping 220 kV straight to 10 kV with a patented high-impedance split-winding transformer
targetSegments: hyperscale tenants in national hub nodes

productsAndServices.name: SST intelligent DC power — the Sangyuan project (with Meituan, HEC and Delta)
productsAndServices.description: Chindata's Sangyuan base in Huailai runs a solid-state-transformer DC power system for Meituan, declared in formal commercial operation on 2 Jul 2026: a '10 kV delta-connected' SST converting 10 kV AC to 800 V DC in one step at 98.5% efficiency, with storage integrated for peak-valley arbitrage and backup. Chindata says it built the SST specification 'from 0 to 1' and led the full-chain design over 34 tests; Delta supplied the indoor SST (SiC high-frequency conversion, solid insulation, 1 MW per cabinet in one square metre, 240/400/800 V DC outputs); HEC supplied custom stacked-foil capacitor banks; Meituan leases the hall long-term. Chindata says it will 'steadily expand' SST use and work with domestic equipment makers on core components to accelerate localisation.
highlights: Dates differ by source: unveiled at CDCC 20 Nov 2025; Delta's February 2026 brand-news issue says Chindata "formally implemented" the SST, with a launch ceremony but no date; a trade post of 29 Jan 2026 expected use from April 2026; Chindata dates formal commercial operation to 2 Jul 2026. DG Matrix's republished June 2026 piece says it "went live" in February 2026
HEC's inquiry reply: 'the Sangyuan project has deployed an SST–HVDC–integrated lithium-storage scheme'
Project MW and the isolation frequency are not disclosed; Delta says upgrading only the power system can accommodate several thousand additional AI servers
productsAndServices.positioning: Chindata calls it 'the industry's first commercial SST intelligent DC power project for a compute centre'; Eaton says its MV SST pilot at a VNET site with a leading internet company has run since end-2024 and claims the first SST deployment in an internet data centre — Chindata's claim holds with the 'commercial' qualifier
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Built into the tenant's leased hall; equipment bought from Delta and HEC
productsAndServices.roadmap: Scale SST use across campuses and localise core components with domestic makers (July 2026)

productsAndServices.name: Power engineering products — 玄铁 800 V HVDC module, 磐石 modular architecture, MV UPS
productsAndServices.description: Chindata's own designs: the 玄铁 (Xuantie) power module v3.0 'supports 12 kW to 150 kW per rack and uses an 800 V high-voltage DC architecture'; the 磐石 (Panshi) modular architecture of six systems and 24 product modules; a medium-voltage UPS (battery clusters on a high-voltage cascaded inverter with a static bypass); an integrated low-voltage power module (UPS, switchgear and battery cabling in one prefabricated enclosure); factory-prefabricated power modules from medium voltage through gensets, transformers and UPS to HVDC; and storage at the grid entry, the room distribution and the rack end to absorb transient spikes. HEC's filing states the architecture: 'an 800 V HVDC scheme combined with solid-state transformers and other equipment'.
highlights: Own substations as standard; the CTO (Sep 2026) calls for dedicated 500 kV stations for GW campuses
Power density in operation: 7.2–50 kW racks; the Lingqiu phase-8 hall runs 42 kW racks; liquid cooling above 120 kW started at Qingyang
The prefabrication subsidiaries stayed with Bain's side at the sale; IP-sharing ended 31 Aug 2025
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Internal design; equipment bought from vendors

productsAndServices.name: Cooling — 玄冰 maglev phase-change and liquid cooling
productsAndServices.description: The 玄冰 (Xuanbing) maglev phase-change cooling line in air, liquid and hybrid versions supports racks 'above 200 kW'; the filing lists indirect evaporative cooling, waterless cooling (WUE ≈ 0, CLF ≤ 0.13), high-reliability liquid-cooling CDUs and evaporative cold-plate liquid cooling among ten in-house core technologies. PUE averaged 1.21 in 2025 and 1.18 in Feb 2026; the Lingqiu hybrid-cooled hall runs at 1.13.
highlights: Cooling JV with Envicool (91/9); HVAC from Shenling; HEC contributes liquid-cooling components and fluorinated coolants

productsAndServices.name: NEXT full-stack solution and asset-light operations
productsAndServices.description: The NEXT full-stack compute-centre solution, launched at CDCC on 20 Nov 2025 with Morong Electric, Eimicon, Shenling and Delta, covers power intake, distribution, cooling and operations and adds IT-level energy storage. A July 2025 framework with Ping An Trust and Ping An Infrastructure Fund has Chindata providing O&M and valuation services for data centres Ping An owns.
highlights: The 鲲鹏智维 O&M platform claims fault-prediction accuracy above 95% (Nov 2025) or about 98% (Jul 2026)

strategyRead: (High confidence) We assess that Chindata China is the named reference site for solid-state transformers in Chinese AI data centres, and that it is now looking for a domestic supply chain behind the first vendor. Basis: formal commercial operation of the Delta SST at Sangyuan on 2 Jul 2026; Chindata's statement that it will 'steadily expand' SST use and work 'with domestic equipment makers on core components, accelerating localisation of key parts'; HEC's filing naming the house architecture as 800 V HVDC combined with SSTs; a named SST R&D lead (Wang Hao) and an electrical architect who writes technical specifications and runs factory acceptance (Rao Zhiren). Indicator to watch: a second SST project, or a named domestic SST supplier, in Chindata or HEC disclosures.

(High confidence) We assess that selling power equipment to Chindata means passing two gates — the landlord's architecture and the tenant's approved list. Basis: HEC's filing states that for equipment Chindata tenders among the vendors on the customer's qualified-vendor list and then buys that vendor's UPS; the named UPS and power-module supplier is Changshan Beiming (18.2% of 2024 equipment spend), with Eaton through its designated agent. For a vendor absent from the tenant's list, the landlord's own specification work — the SST programme, 800 V HVDC, storage — is the door, not the UPS tender.

(High confidence) We assess the business as a single-tenant credit with a 2027 renewal cliff that the new owner is trying to dilute. Basis: Customer A at about 90% of revenue on mostly 10-year contracts, identified in the filing only through Volcano Engine self-build projects; the first wholesale contract expiring in November 2027 with no renewal talks begun; HEC tabling Customer A's own campus build as a risk; and 824 MW of 2026 orders including several hundred MW from a newly won top internet company. The two concentration figures (about 80% on Chindata's page, about 90% in HEC's filing) are not reconciled by any source.

(Moderate confidence) We assess that HEC ownership pulls procurement toward the owner's own components where they exist. Basis: HEC supplied the stacked-foil capacitors in the Sangyuan SST and describes its supercapacitors as usable for transient buffering in SST equipment; it makes liquid-cooling parts and fluorinated coolants; Sungrow signed SST framework purchase agreements with HEC Technology at its July 2026 launch, with no disclosed link to a Chindata campus; the CEO is also an HEC Group senior vice president. Inference: the owner is assembling a capacitor-to-campus stack, and vendors should expect HEC content in the bill of materials.

(Moderate confidence) We assess that the next equipment wave is large and dated. Basis: RMB4.75B of mechanical and electrical spend earmarked in the share-raise projects (Ulanqab Huiteng No.5 phase 1 RMB2.45B, Lingqiu phases 10–11 RMB1.88B, Qingyang RMB0.42B), each with a 12-month build; 2,289 MW to start by 2028. The equipment line fell to RMB673M in 2025 during the sale, so 2026–2027 purchasing restarts from a low base. Indicator to watch: SSE approval and CSRC registration of HEC's share issue, which releases the raise.

relationships.note: Chindata China's 'Customer A' takes about 90% of revenue; HEC's filing never names it but lists its own campuses as Volcano Engine (ByteDance) projects, and ByteDance was 86.3% of Chindata's revenue in 2022.
relationships.context: Customer A: 91.00% of 2024, 90.12% of 2025 and 90.22% of Jan–Feb 2026 revenue (HEC reply, 23 Sep 2026); the SSE work letter and Chindata's profile page give 80.23% for 2024 and 83.54% for Jan–May 2025 — no source reconciles the two. The reply's section on Customer A's own build lists 火山引擎长三角算力中心 (306 MW), 长三角无为算力中心 (335 MW), 火山云太行算力中心 phase 2 (~187 MW) and 内蒙古和林格尔算力中心 (220 MW). The first wholesale contract expires in November 2027. ByteDance is also the anchor tenant of MY06 in Johor, operated by Bridge Data Centres — now a separate Bain-controlled company.

relationships.note: Delta supplied the solid-state transformer at the Sangyuan SST project, built with Meituan and HEC and in formal operation since 2 Jul 2026; Delta is also a partner in Chindata's NEXT full-stack solution.
relationships.context: The solution was unveiled at CDCC on 20 Nov 2025; Delta's February 2026 brand-news issue says Chindata 'formally implemented' the Delta SST with a launch ceremony but gives no date; a trade post of 29 Jan 2026 expected use from April; Chindata dates formal commercial operation to 2 Jul 2026, after 34 tests. Delta: SiC high-frequency conversion, solid insulation, 1 MW per cabinet in one square metre, 240/400/800 V DC outputs. Chindata: 10 kV delta-connected, 10 kV AC to 800 V DC in one step, 98.5%. Project MW not disclosed.

policyExposure.regime: East Data, West Computing (东数西算)
policyExposure.exposure: HEC's filing quotes the rule that new large or hyperscale data centres should in principle be built only in national hub nodes, with PUE no higher than 1.25. Chindata's Feb 2026 average PUE was 1.18 and all its long-term projects sit in hub nodes (Zhangjiakou, Ulanqab, Qingyang, Zhongwei, Shaoguan, Yangtze Delta).

policyExposure.regime: Foreign ownership of value-added telecom (IDC licence)
policyExposure.exposure: Foreign investors may hold at most 50% of a value-added telecom business, which is why US-listed Chindata ran its IDC business through six VIE structures. They were terminated at the sale to domestic owners; the IDC licence is held by 北京秦淮数据有限公司.

CTO Xue Guoqing (Sep 2026) notes that compute–power coordination was written into the government work report for the first time; Chindata's direct-green-power zone at Ulanqab and source-grid-load-storage work at Zhongwei follow it.

background: Joined 2023; leads R&D on liquid cooling and solid-state transformers and on bringing power modules and SSTs into production (HEC reply)
Formerly Baidu planning-design architect and head of North China operations; North China Electric Power University

background: Joined 2026; registered electrical engineer; led 110 kV substation and electrical design for 40–100 MW campuses
Writes technical specifications, reviews designs and runs vendor factory acceptance (HEC reply); formerly deputy design director at Puping Data
